description: This file defines a utility function `shapeAgentGroupedSeries` that processes an array of cost records, grouping and aggregating them by agent and an additional categorization (like environment or cost category). It prepares data suitable for visualization with a charting library like Recharts, filling in missing categories with zero and sorting as specified.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw records into a grouped dataset with zero-filled categories, suitable for visualization, grouped by agent and an optional secondary dimension.
